newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-TANZANIA AND ZIMBABWE FACE FIFA SANCTIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TANZANIA AND ZIMBABWE FACE FIFA SANCTIONS.

text.p: Zimbabwe and Tanzania face possible exclusion from international soccer for playing in an unsanctioned tournament, FIFA said on Tuesday.
The two countries met in Harare on Sunday in the opening match of the Castle Cup, a tournament which FIFA said had yet to receive official approval.

FIFA said warnings had been issued to Tanzania and Zimbabwe along with the other participants, Namibia, Zambia and Mozambique, not to play in the competition until the executive committee examine the matter at its next meeting on December 7.
Zimbabwe and Tanzania have been given until October 10 to submit explanations to soccer's world governing body.
